name: Tight chugs before the amp
desc: Fast gate before a high-gain amp; 120 Hz sidechain low cut makes palm-mute stops snap shut in ~10 ms

refs.why: staccato riffs with dead-silent stops between mutes, gate set for it
refs.source: Reverb.com, Misha Mansoor outlines the ultimate metal pedalboard (undated)

notes: golem's Chug-tight from the design doc. hpf 120 Hz shrinks the close window to 10 ms (tighter, not just less sensitive); follow keeps held chords
